name: Styramate
summary: Styramate (brand name Sinaxar) is a muscle relaxant and anticonvulsant drug. At therapeutic doses, it does not produce significant sedative effects.

uses.en: It was used as a muscle relaxant and anticonvulsant under the brand name Sinaxar.
uses.zh: 它曾以Sinaxar為商品名，作為肌肉鬆弛劑與抗癲癇藥使用。
uses.zhHans: 它曾以Sinaxar为商品名，作为肌肉松弛剂与抗癫痫药使用。

fact.en: Styramate is a carbamate, a chemical relative of older muscle relaxants and tranquillisers such as meprobamate and methocarbamol.
fact.zh: Styramate是一種胺甲酸酯，與甲丙氨酯、美索巴莫等較早期的肌肉鬆弛劑和鎮靜劑屬於化學上的近親。
fact.zhHans: Styramate是一种胺甲酸酯，与甲丙氨酯、美索巴莫等较早期的肌肉松弛剂和镇静剂属于化学上的近亲。
